answer: A meadow holds thirty marble plots each epoch; each marble answers one signal. A claimant plants a block-seeded marble in one plot in fifteen minutes; three strangers must hear its signal live, at most two each. Entry locks 75 POA, +35 per extra identity from one root: ten linked fakes lock 2,325 POA. One operator tends two meadows at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten plantings, thirty hearings, fifteen strangers at once. A missed signal burns 20; one marble heard at two meadows burns both bonds. Signal times are checked against funding roots: a root behind ten plots keeps only one.
